fix(auth): proxy /api/auth and /api/v1 through Next.js to fix cross-browser cookie reliability

- Add Next.js rewrites in next.config.ts to proxy /api/auth/* and /api/v1/* to Railway backend
- Update auth client baseURL to use same-origin (window.location.origin) instead of Railway URL directly
- Set baseURL='' in all frontend API files so calls use relative URLs through the proxy
- Root cause: cross-site cookies with SameSite=None are blocked by Safari, Brave, Firefox in many contexts causing intermittent signin failures
